title: Kiteretsu Daihyakka - Episode 001
description: As the episode starts, the scene cuts back to Kiteretsu's home. He is shown to be sleeping in a bed. A voice calls for him by his name. Kiteretsu is woken up by the voice and puts on his glasses. He goes outside his room and sees Kiteretsu Saisama. Saisama says, 'Did my book, Kiteretsu Daihyakka, I made, be of any help to you?' Kiteretsu goes on to describe many events he experiences with the iconic time machine made by him. Saisama says, 'What? There's something more important than that you are forgetting, that I left for you.' Saisama's figure goes backwards rapidly as clouds of dust and smoke cover the place. Kiteretsu goes after him after asking what that important thing is. After he wakes up, his mom tells Kiteretsu several things to buy from the grocery store. Korosuke, after hiding to escape grocery duty, decides he will make something with Kiteretsu Daihyakka. After an explosion occurs, the book is taken by Kiteretsu's mom, after which they share a heartwarming scene about how much effort it took to make him by his creator. Korosuke decides to leave home and go to Miyoko's house after an argument with Kiteretsu. He tells Miyoko that he is going on a long trip. After Korosuke is bullied by Buta Gorilla at the local park and is robbed of his money, Kiteretsu goes on a search for Korosuke, and they find him. They have a reunion, and Kiteretsu says, 'In the time you weren't there, I realized that the important thing Kiteretsu Saisama was talking about was you, Korosuke.'
